description:
For node 42 the system defines two contextual actions within the “node” group. The first action, titled **View** (translation context “node”), links to the canonical route `entity.node.canonical` with the parameter `node = 42`. It carries a weight of 0 and is rendered with the CSS classes `contextual-link` and `node-view`; hovering over it shows the tooltip “View this content”. This action is implemented by the class `Drupal
ode\Plugin\Action\View`, derived via `Drupal
ode\Plugin\Deriver\NodeDeriver`, and its cache is tagged with `node:42` and `node_list`.

The second action, titled **Edit** (also in the “node” translation context), points to the edit-form route `entity.node.edit_form`, again passing `node = 42` as a parameter. Assigned a weight of 10, it uses the CSS classes `contextual-link` and `node‑edit`, and displays the tooltip “Edit this content”. Its implementation class is `Drupal
ode\Plugin\Action\Edit`, uses the same deriver `Drupal
ode\Plugin\Deriver\NodeDeriver`, and shares the cache tags `node:42` and `node_list`.
